pr_title: [3.x] Mark debugger limits settings as requiring a restart
pr_body:
These settings are only read once on engine initialization.

- This closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/81694.

Yeah I think it's a good workflow :+1:

issue_context.title: Cannot toggle editor output limit '[output overflow, print less text!]'
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

v3.5.2.stable.official

### System information

Win10

### Issue description

Cannot toggle the editor showing the message  [output overflow, print less text!] after it shows a certain amount of text.

Even something simple like print(get_tree().root.print_tree_pretty()) can trigger this message,so we cannot see results of a basic function.

### Steps to reproduce

1) Load an basic project with small number of nodes
2) add line print(get_tree().root.print_tree_pretty())
3)Note that you will be unable to see the printed tree as it shows " [output overflow, print less text!]" on output panel
4) Cannot toggle, or turn off this setting (solutions discussed in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/4192 do not work)

### Minimal reproduction project

N/A
comments:
The output overflow check uses `max_cps`, which is defined by **Max Chars Per Second** project setting:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/98fe7f4a30d2bb4dbc8cb49dda5671302adc1bd1/scene/debugger/script_debugger_remote.cpp#L1203

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/98fe7f4a30d2bb4dbc8cb49dda5671302adc1bd1/scene/debugger/script_debugger_remote.cpp#L1106

Remember to restart the editor after changing this setting.
Reopening, as project settings hint need to be changed to reflect this.

review_comments: If there are more settings that need the change, maybe this one could be put into another PR addressing a bunch of misc settings, given that this one doesn't belong to the category the PR title suggests.
